authorization: Parent explicitly starts measurements only after all concurrent builds/checks stop.
comparison_design: Incremental adoption: M2 over accepted M1; M3 over the latest accepted head after the M2 decision. No pooling across comparison_id, accepted_head or source/binary hashes.

m3_control_first.decision: Stop the unchanged original M3 patch on confirmed regression; broader cases require a separate root decision.

order: Sequential suites; within each fixture A/A then A/B then allocation diagnostics where specified. Pairs alternate AB/BA. No warmup dropping or outlier removal.

analysis.bootstrap: 10000 deterministic whole-pair resamples; seed 20261025; percentile 95% interval for 100*(1-after_mean/before_mean)
analysis.aa_noise_floor: max absolute matching A/A CI endpoint, independently per fixture/stage/case/config/baseline hash and comparison phase
analysis.strict_gain_gate: gain CI lower > A/A noise floor
analysis.strict_regression_gate: gain CI upper < negative A/A noise floor
analysis.gate_status: Carried forward unchanged from the prior independently reviewed analyzer, chosen before these adoption measurements. Descriptive conservative gate, not a calibrated joint hypothesis test; no multiplicity adjustment.
analysis.allocation_acceptance: Reproducible useful counts may justify a simple change without a proven E2E gain. Instrumented wall/CPU cannot establish speed or regression. Whole-scan allocation deltas need not equal theoretical removed allocations because runtime/channel allocation varies.

scope_limits: Windows performance only; Linux checks establish correctness, not performance.
E2E CPU/RSS combines sender and receiver in one process on localhost; source and output share a volume.
Cache/background activity uncontrolled; preparation and verification may warm subsequent observations.
Control wall and allocator intervals cover only the loop; CPU/cycle snapshots are slightly wider. No noop subtraction. Reference encode/decode occurs before timing.
Stage RSS is process lifetime highwater. Requested allocation bytes are not live memory or RSS.
A noisy inconclusive E2E comparison cannot prove absence of small regressions.
Prior M1 artifact reuse pins source/compiler/binary evidence. It does not imply a fresh rebuild from the final commit with documentation changes.
